_doc: Packs per sealed product and the slot structure of one booster pack. Lookup order for packs: setOverrides[groupId][type] -> eraOverrides[era][type] -> defaults[type]. Every build cross-checks these counts against the pack count parsed from each product's tcgcsv CardText and reports mismatches in build-report.packCountMismatches.

packs._defaultsSource: Verified 2026-10-27 against tcgcsv CardText for every SV/ME set with these products (e.g. '9 Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution booster packs', '11 ... booster packs' for Pokémon Center ETBs, 'six booster packs' for bundles, '36 booster packs' for boxes).
packs._eraOverridesSource: SWSH ETB CardText: 'eight/8 ... booster packs'; SWSH Pokémon Center ETB CardText: '10 booster packs' (Evolving Skies, Brilliant Stars, Silver Tempest). The spec's 11 applies to SV/ME only.

promoValue._doc: Optional USD value added to a product's EV for its included promo card(s). ETB promos live in a separate promo group on TCGplayer and are not auto-linked, so the default is 0. The set page lets users enter a value.

pools._doc: Filler pools: what a slot yields when no hit tier is drawn. `tiers` are the card tiers in the pool; `variants` is the price-variant preference (first variant with a price wins). The reverse pool takes only the Reverse Holofoil printing of C/U/R cards, plus cards whose tier is 'Reverse Holo' (pattern-foil reverse products).

layouts._doc: Slots of one booster pack. A slot with `hits` draws one hit tier with that tier's per-pack odds (they share the slot, so their odds must sum to <= 1); otherwise it yields a uniform draw from `pool`. A slot with count > 1 must not list hits (odds are per pack). Which slot a tier occupies only affects co-occurrence in the Monte Carlo, never the EV. Slot placement follows TCGplayer's articles ('in the Rare slot', 'in the first/second Reverse Holo slot'). A set can move a tier with pullrates.sets[id].tierSlots.

sv._source: SV/ME packs: 4 Common, 3 Uncommon, 2 Reverse Holo, 1 Rare (+ basic Energy and code card, not valued).

swsh._source: SWSH packs: 5 Common, 3 Uncommon, 1 Reverse Holo, 1 Rare (+ basic Energy and code card). Radiant Rares replace a Common (Crown Zenith: the Reverse Holo, set via tierSlots); Trainer/Galarian Gallery replaces the Reverse Holo.

30c._source: TCGplayer 30th Celebration article: 5 foil cards; Illustration Rare / Classic Collection appear 'in the third slot', Double Rare / SIR / Futuristic Rare 'in the fourth slot', a Pikachu Rare is 'guaranteed in the last slot'. Filler composition of slots 1-4 is an assumption (all bulk-priced).
